qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the Torx screws used on the F clutch on the transmission case?
qa_pairs.answer: The Torx screws for F clutch on transmission case (4HP-22/4HP-24) require 10 Nm torque.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is specified for the ASS 560Z component?
qa_pairs.answer: The ASS 560Z component uses M8 screws with a torque specification of 23 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque value for the brake band adjusting screw?
qa_pairs.answer: The brake band adjusting screw (A 4 S 270 R/A 4 S 310 R) requires 5 Nm torque with a 5/16" screw size.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is used for the lock nut of brake band adjusting screw?
qa_pairs.answer: The lock nut of brake band adjusting screw uses a 5/16" screw size.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the lock nut of brake band adjusting screw?
qa_pairs.answer: The lock nut of brake band adjusting screw (A 4 S 270 R/A 4 S 310 R) requires 21 Nm torque.

qa_pairs.question: What transmission types are specified for the Torx screws in item 1AZ?
qa_pairs.answer: The Torx screws for F clutch are specified for 4HP-22/4HP-24 transmission types.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this page belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: This page belongs to section 24-8 Automatic Transmission, specifically covering Shift Clutches (24 23).

qa_pairs.question: What is the screw size for the Torx screws used on the transmission case F clutch?
qa_pairs.answer: The Torx screws for F clutch on transmission case use M6 screws.

qa_pairs.question: Which components in the shift clutches section use the same transmission type designation?
qa_pairs.answer: The brake band adjusting screw (2AZ) and lock nut of brake band adjusting screw (3AZ) both use the A 4 S 270 R/A 4 S 310 R transmission type designation.
